summary: FedEx filed an 8-K reporting the results of its September 28, 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, covering Item 5.07 vote tallies for the election of eleven directors and an advisory say-on-pay resolution, with no special-situation transaction disclosed. All eleven nominees were elected with more votes for than against. The say-on-pay proposal passed with roughly 168.9 million votes for, about 90.6% of voted shares, and 16.7 million against. The next annual meeting is scheduled for April 26, 2027. No deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply to this routine governance filing.
